*{{PAGENAME}}'s SPA cannot be affect by [[Powerups|Stats]] or [[Traits]], but can be affected by [[Powerups|Curses]].

*After Update 14.0.0, {{PAGENAME}} has been given the {{Damage Type|Light}} damage type, along with other units without a second damage type.
